name: Rory Lancman
bottom_line: Most of his résumé checks out: Assembly, City Council, state ratepayer counsel, NIFA vice chair and Great Neck Library president. Record claims about lowering costs and "record fines" on PSEG overstate what the public record shows for his part.
findings: Offices and appointments are confirmed by state and press sources.
PSEG Long Island forfeited $30 million after Tropical Storm Isaias, but through a LIPA settlement; the site gives no figure and does not say what was his role.
page_issues: Says he oversaw the PSC, but the ratepayer counsel post sat inside the Department of Public Service.
